name: Two pending orders 2
summary: This EA places two pending orders (a Buy Stop and a Sell Stop) at a configurable distance from the current price at the start of each new bar. It uses an OCO (One-Cancels-the-Other) logic where once one pending order is triggered, the opposite pending order is deleted, capturing breakout moves in either direction.
summary_zh: 该EA在每个新K线开始时，在当前价格上下方设定距离处放置两个挂单（买入止损和卖出止损）。采用OCO（一取消另一）逻辑，当一个挂单被触发后，删除反方向挂单，以捕捉任意方向的突破行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双向突破策略，在每个新K线开盘时在当前价格上下方各放置一个止损挂单（Buy Stop和Sell Stop），等待价格突破任一方向后入场。入场条件为价格突破预设距离的高点或低点，属于典型的突破策略。出场条件依赖止损和止盈参数，以及OCO机制——当一方挂单成交后自动删除另一方挂单，避免双向持仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，由用户通过参数设定，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏最大持仓限制、最大回撤保护或账户余额比例计算，风险控制完全依赖用户手动设置合理的止损止盈值。该策略适合波动较大的市场环境，但在震荡行情中可能频繁触发止损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a dual-direction breakout strategy by placing a Buy Stop and a Sell Stop order at a configurable distance above and below the current price at the start of each new bar. Entry conditions are based on price breaking through a predefined distance from the current price level, which is a classic breakout approach. Exit conditions rely on stop-loss and take-profit parameters, along with the OCO (One-Cancels-the-Other) mechanism where the opposite pending order is deleted once one side is triggered, preventing opposing positions. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size determined by the user through input parameters, with no dynamic position sizing or risk-based lot calculation. Money management is minimal, lacking maximum position limits, drawdown protection, or percentage-of-balance sizing, leaving risk control entirely to the user's manual configuration of stop-loss and take-profit values. The strategy is well-suited for volatile market conditions but may suffer frequent stop-outs during ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.name: PendingDistance
parameters.description: 挂单距离当前价格的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from current price in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: OCO机制确保只持有一个方向仓位，避免对冲风险
双向挂单设计能捕捉任意方向的突破行情，不错过大波动
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
每根K线重新设置挂单，能动态适应价格变化
支持自定义止损止盈，风险参数透明可控
pros_en: OCO mechanism ensures only one directional position is held, avoiding hedging risk
Dual pending order design captures breakouts in either direction without missing major moves
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Pending orders are re-placed at each new bar, dynamically adapting to price changes
Customizable stop-loss and take-profit provide transparent and controllable risk parameters
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数不考虑账户资金变化
没有震荡市场过滤机制，在横盘行情中容易被频繁止损
缺少最大持仓数和最大回撤保护等资金管理功能
没有扩展点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损止盈可能不合理
每根K线都删除并重新放置挂单，可能增加交易成本和滑点风险
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size ignores account equity changes
No ranging market filter, leading to frequent stop-outs during sideways markets
Missing money management features like max position count and drawdown protection
No spread filter, making stop-loss and take-profit potentially unreasonable during high-spread conditions
Deleting and re-placing pending orders every bar may increase trading costs and slippage risk
improvements: 添加ATR或波动率指标动态调整挂单距离和止损止盈，适应不同市场波动环境
增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向）或震荡指标，避免在横盘行情中频繁入场
实现基于账户余额比例的动态仓位管理，提高资金使用效率和安全性
improvements_en: Add ATR or volatility-based dynamic adjustment for pending order distance and stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to varying market volatility
Incorporate a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) or oscillator to avoid frequent entries during ranging markets
Implement equity-proportional dynamic position sizing to improve capital efficiency and safety

risk_points: 固定手数不考虑账户资金比例，大仓位可能导致重大亏损
缺乏横盘市场过滤，震荡行情中频繁止损可能造成累积损失
OCO机制在极端行情下（如跳空）可能未能及时删除反方向挂单
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size without equity-proportional sizing can lead to significant losses with oversized positions
Lack of ranging market filter may cause cumulative losses from frequent stop-outs during choppy conditions
OCO mechanism may fail to delete the opposite pending order in extreme market conditions such as price gaps

It uses an OCO (One-Cancels-the-Other) logic where once one pending order is triggered, the opposite pending order is deleted, capturing breakout moves in either direction.
